$comment: SC-OWNED IMMUTABLE VISUAL AUTHORITY MANIFEST — C907 §0.1(5) FINAL RULING.
'A changed golden image without a corresponding reviewed SC identity change must fail the release gate.'
This file lives under scripts/, so it is inside the SC fingerprint. Changing any sha256 below moves SC,
which is exactly the reviewed identity change the ruling requires. Editing a golden PNG without editing
this file fails verify-golden-authority.mjs; editing this file without a ruling moves SC and is visible
in the candidate's identity. Neither can be done quietly.
A frame whose status is PENDING has NO approved golden capture. The gate refuses to certify it rather
than comparing it against nothing — an absent authority is not a passing one.
